releases.summary: Halia's held staffs are drawn at a normal size again.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Staff of Bursting Mana, the Staff of Warped Space and Sage's Rod were drawn far too large when held. They now draw at a normal size when held, in first person and in third person. (Halia V1.4.0.37)

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requirements are unchanged from 1.4.0.

releases.title: Halia V1.4.0.36 — fixes from a large round of testing
releases.summary: Halia's large round of testing found and fixed these problems. Arcana staffs and blades work for new players again, and many in-game texts now show their proper names.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Arcana staffs and blades could not be used by new players, because their mana limit was lower than what they cost. New players now start with far more mana, and the damage stays balanced.
A short 'not enough mana' notice now appears when a spell cannot be paid for.
Usurper's Edge now really blocks, and its Vengeance effect works.
The Staff of Bursting Mana's area volley discs now face you. In most directions they were drawn turned the wrong way.
Hundreds of in-game texts and book entries across the Arcana, Halia Vigil and other parts showed raw internal text instead of their names. They are fixed in English and Japanese.
Helion, the Sun Chieftain could crash a server when hit by a player. Fixed.
The Blade art Drive did not fly. It flies now.
The Mana Circuit and the Circle Projector dropped nothing when broken. They now drop themselves, and several more blocks drop the right items.
The Watch Eye showed a missing texture in the inventory and in the held view. Fixed.
The Talon Wrench was not recognised by the Aerie blocks. Fixed.
A dedicated server could crash when a block's owner was changed. Fixed.
The Device Lifter is off by default. It now tells you so, instead of silently doing nothing.
Reinforcing and unreinforcing scaffolding no longer returns an empty result.
Beams with no caster no longer cause an error. Fae, Familiar and Venom Jar now have their drops set explicitly.
Owners can open their Warded Dispenser, Warded Dropper and Warded Hopper again (opening them threw an error).

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requirements are unchanged from 1.4.0.

releases.title: Halia V1.4 — the Arcana, six creatures, and three bosses
releases.summary: Halia V1.4 adds the Arcana, Halia's magic: 53 spell circles, 44 spell scrolls, two staves and Sage's Rod. It adds six creatures that live across the Overworld, the Nether and the End, three bosses that wait in their own structures, and the monastery of Daigan the Stoneshaper, whose climbing trial rewards the Quarry Gauntlet.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Arcana: 53 spell circles, each with its own block, and 44 spell scrolls, among them Downpour of Light, Shifting Ward, Gaze of Binding and Summon Familiar. The staves are the Staff of Bursting Mana, the Staff of Warped Space and Sage's Rod; the Circle Projector is also part of the Arcana.
Glimmerwisp: lives in dark forests of the Overworld and in the highlands and midlands of the End.
Snaremaw: lives in jungles and in the crimson forests of the Nether. Plant a Snaremaw Seed on grass, dirt or leaves; feed the sprout meat and it grows into a snaremaw.

Gemback: lives underground in the Overworld, outside the mushroom fields, and in the wastes of the Nether. Mine it with a Silk Touch pickaxe to get a Captured Gemback; place that item to let the Gemback go. The Gemback block is in the game too.
Cragling: lives in the dripstone caves of the Overworld and the basalt deltas of the Nether. Its Cragling Rod is a material; its stone spikes and ground fissures are its attacks.

Duskprowler: the Duskprowler Howler leads a pack of Duskprowlers in the jungles. Duskprowlers can drop Moon Paws, five kinds (Full, Gibbous, Half, Crescent and New Moon Paw), with a chance that looting raises; each paw has its own effect.

Cliff Wyrm: lives on the stony shores of the Overworld above y 68 and in the End's highlands. It spits Poison Balls; its Wyrm Fang makes the Fang Dagger, which poisons on every hit. Poison Resistance cures and blocks poison.
Forgebound Colossus, the first boss: in its underground colossus chamber in the Overworld, and in a Nether chamber of its own. Its items are the Colossus Greataxe and the Colossus Helm.
Rimefang, the second boss: in its lair in the Overworld, and in an End lair. It breathes freezing air, and its Rime Crystal lets you breathe a freezing wind while you hold right-click.

Daigan the Stoneshaper, the last boss: a trader in his monastery in the Overworld. He sets a climbing trial over trial platforms, and some of them crumble soon after you stand on them. The trial's reward is the Quarry Gauntlet, which charges and throws boulders, rolls, slams and raises pillars. He also has a staff and an armour set of beads, robe, belt and sandals.

The Sunmask people: masked tribes of the savanna and, now, the Nether's crimson forests and wastes. The Sunmask Raider roams with a ring of followers; the Sunmask and the Sunmask Seer keep the groves, and the Seer shields its kin and heals their chieftain. Each kind wears its own mask, with a sun behind its head while it fights.

Helion, the Sun Chieftain: the boss on the throne of every Sunmask grove, in the Overworld and the Nether. He calls down sunstrikes, and, once his health falls to three fifths, sweeps the ground with Helion's Lance and swells into Corona Burst.

Trade with Helion: a player who wears a Sunmask's mask may give him seven gold blocks for Helion's Favour. Blessed, an empty hand calls a sunstrike, sneaking calls Helion's Lance, and holding both buttons while sneaking calls Corona Burst, each paid from the blessing's time.
The Solar Countenance: worn on the head, it lets a masked player summon up to ten Sunmask Raider Followers from Sunmask masks; they follow and defend their summoner.
Daigan's monastery now also stands on the End's outer islands, built of end stone and purpur.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requirements: Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, Java 25. For multiplayer, Halia must also be installed on the server.
Halia V1.4 now uses GeckoLib 5.5.6. It comes inside the Halia jar, so there is nothing extra to install; if another mod brings the same GeckoLib, the game uses one copy.
Each creature's natural spawning can be switched off per creature from the Corvus app. The switches are locked on for two months after the release of V1.4; the lock's end date is set on release day.

releases.title: Halia V1.3 — the Vigil, 46 doors, and the Doorwright's Bench
releases.summary: Halia V1.3 adds the Vigil, a set of devices for guarding what you build: warded blocks only their owner can break, cameras, code locks, pass readers, snares and turrets. It also adds 46 doors, hatches and gates that open with real motion, and the Doorwright's Bench, where you design your own door.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Vigil: 593 warded versions of building blocks, broken only by their owner; Watch Eyes you can look through from a Watch Slate; Code Plates, Coded Doors, Coded Chests and other coded containers; Watch Passes and Pass Readers; Tripbeams, Stir Lamps and the Klaxon; 40 snares disguised as ordinary blocks; and the Watch Turret, which shoots hostile mobs that come into range.

46 doors, hatches and gates with real motion: Cell Bars, glass sliders, the Clean-room Door, the Foundry Door, the Paper Screen Door, 16 Drapes, six Floor and Slide Hatches, the Tavern Doors and the Bulkhead Door.

Big doors: eight 3 x 3 Grand Gates, the 3 x 2 Iris Door, the Roller Shutter (a stack of panels that rolls up into the ceiling), the 2 x 2 Corroded Hatch with its ladder, and the Barrier Veil, a wall of light you raise between two corners with the Veil Emitter.
The Coach-house Door and the Keep Door: 4 x 5 double doors whose frame is made of the block you craft them with (one door and five or more of one block).
The Mimic Fence Gate takes on the look of the blocks on either side of it.

The Doorwright's Bench: choose one of 18 movements, the opening time, auto-close, opening when a player comes near, the redstone rule, the double-door pairing, one of 12 sounds and a code of up to six digits, then make a Crafted Door from any frame block and two panel blocks (fire, a portal, water and lava too). Crafted doors can be re-set at the bench later.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requirements: Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, Java 25. For multiplayer, Halia must also be installed on the server.

Fixed: since V1.2, breaking an Aerie storage block dropped it without the link to what it stored, so a moved block came back empty. It now keeps its contents. Contents already lost this way cannot be restored.
Worlds from V1.2 open as they are. Do not go back to 1.2 with a world that holds Vigil devices or the new doors: they would be deleted.

releases.title: Halia V1.2 — the Aerie storage network, 20 new blades with 7 new arts, and SS-05
releases.summary: Halia V1.2 adds the Aerie, a storage network you build from an Aerie Heart, conduits and cells: every item and fluid you own, searchable from one console, moved in and out by Talon Intakes and Outlets and crafted on demand by Artificers. The Halia Blade gains 20 named blades, 7 slash arts, and souls that a blade collects and spends.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Aerie: place an Aerie Heart, join devices with Aerie Conduits, put Clutch Cells in a Clutch Bay, and open a Roost Console to see and search everything stored. 37 kinds of device, most of them in 16 colours.

Moving and crafting: Talon Intakes and Outlets move items and fluids between the Aerie and any chest or machine; Artificers craft on demand from patterns written at a Scribe Console; Updraft Masts and Field Consoles reach the Aerie without wires.
Power with OUKA: if OUKA is installed, the Aerie Heart draws its power from OUKA's Tesla pylon grid. Without OUKA the Aerie needs no power.

20 new named blades: the Gale Fang and Tempest Fang lines, Ironcrag, Ashen Crag, six Plumes from wood to netherite, the Weathered Blade, Evenfall, Heartwood and the Raptors. Most are forged on the anvil from a material box; some drop from bosses; zombies sometimes carry a Weathered Blade; and a nameless blade on a stand caught in a Wither's blast becomes the Ashen Crag.
7 new slash arts: Blossom End, Void Slash, Circle Slash, Vertical and Horizontal Drive, Wave Edge and Piercing. Drives send a flying slash ahead of you.
Souls: a blade held while you defeat enemies gathers souls from their experience. Summoned swords now cost souls instead of experience, and refining a blade on the anvil gives it souls.
Durability and refining: each named blade now has its own durability, and refining raises a blade's damage and its maximum durability (up to refine 200).

Stellar Remote SS-05 Tesseract: a fifth attack, with its own film. A cube of light 640 blocks on a side rises round your crosshair; its ground is cut into cells that are lifted, turned and hung in the air ring by ring from the middle outward, and a cube of light locks in the sky.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requirements: Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, Java 25. For multiplayer, Halia must also be installed on the server.

Changes to V1.1 blades: a blade's hit is 1 lower than before at the same base value; newly made named blades have lower base attack and durability than in V1.1 (for example Yamato: attack 9 → 7, durability 100 → 40); summoned swords need souls. Blades already in your world keep the durability they were made with.
With OUKA installed, the Aerie does not work until its Heart is within reach of a powered pylon. To run it without power beside OUKA, set powerFromOukaGrid to false in config/halia-aerie.json.
Worlds from V1.1 open as they are. Do not go back to 1.1 with a world that holds Aerie devices or the new blades: they would be deleted.
The Stellar Remote destroys very large areas permanently, and SS-05 reshapes a 640-block area at once — back up your world. Anyone standing inside the cube when its wave passes dies.

releases.title: Halia V1.1.1 — fix for a crash with Improved Transparency
releases.summary: Halia V1.1.1 fixes one fault in V1.1.0: with the video setting Improved Transparency turned on, the game closed as soon as a glinting Halia item came into view — for example the soul materials that drop when a blade material box is broken — and the world could not be entered again while those items lay there. Nothing else changed.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Fixed: the game no longer closes when a glinting Halia item is drawn while Improved Transparency is on. Worlds that could not be entered because of this open again.
Everything else is as in V1.1.0: the Halia Blade, its 90 combo moves, the materials, the stands and the Stellar Remote are unchanged.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requirements: Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, Java 25. For multiplayer, Halia must also be installed on the server.
While Improved Transparency is on, two things look different: Halia items do not show the enchantment glint, and the sphere of Judgement Cut appears dark. With the setting off, both look as before.
Worlds from V1.1.0 open as they are. The Stellar Remote still destroys very large areas of the world permanently — back up your world before pressing its button.

releases.title: Halia V1.1 — the Halia Blade: a katana, 90 combo moves and summoned swords
releases.summary: Halia V1.1 adds the Halia Blade, a katana worn at the hip and fought with by timing: combos on the ground and in the air, charged arts, summoned swords, a lock-on, a guard and trick moves. It comes with 8 crafting materials, 6 blade stands and 11 named blades. The Stellar Remote of V1.0 is unchanged.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Halia Blade: craft it from Soulsteel Ingots, a Corvus Soul, an iron sword and a nether brick. Use (right click) attacks; pressing again in time continues the combo — 90 combo moves in all, on the ground and in mid-air.

Charged arts: hold use and release when particles appear for Judgement Cut; release just before they appear for the stronger version. Sneak + forward + use is Rapid Slash, sneak + back + use is Upper Slash.
Summoned swords: the pick-block button (middle click) launches a sword at your target for 1 experience point; four larger patterns — Spiral, Storm, Blistering and Heavy Rain Swords — cost 5 each.

Lock-on, guard and movement: hold sneak to lock on to an enemy; sneaking while standing still guards against ranged attacks; sprint-button tricks dash you to, above or away from an enemy; jump off an enemy or a wall in mid-air.
Concentration rank: landing hits raises a rank shown at the top right, from D up to SSS; it falls again when you stop fighting. High ranks add damage.
Wear, refine and reforge: a blade breaks after 101 hits and drops a soul that keeps its record. On an anvil, a Corvus Soul refines a blade (1 level per soul) and a broken blade can be reforged.
Materials and stands: 8 materials from Tiny Corvus Soul to Abyssal Geode, each with a recipe, and 6 Halia Stands (floor and wall types) to display a blade.
In-game guide: 57 advancements. The "Blade MoveSets" branch lists every move with the keys bound on your computer, and clicking a material or blade advancement shows its recipe.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requirements: Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, Java 25. For multiplayer, Halia must also be installed on the server.
The Stellar Remote still destroys very large areas of the world permanently — back up your world before pressing its button. Nothing about it changed in this version.
Worlds from V1.0.0 open as they are; this version only adds content. Do not go back to 1.0.0 with a world that holds blades, materials or stands: they would be deleted.

Not yet confirmed by the studio: play on a dedicated multiplayer server, Windows, and use together with other Corvus Store mods. In first person the sheathed blade stays mostly out of view until you attack.

groups.summary: Halia V1.0 — the Stellar Remote and three strikes from orbit

releases.title: Halia V1.0 — the Stellar Remote and three strikes from orbit
releases.summary: The first release of Halia (The Max Model), for Minecraft 26.3: the Stellar Remote, one red button that calls down three strikes — SS-01 Railgun, SS-03 Gungnir and SS-04 Seven Stars. They permanently destroy very large areas of the world; read the warnings before you press it.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Stellar Remote: one red button under a flip cover, with its own 3D model. It is in the creative tab "Halia". This version has no crafting recipe for it.

Controls: hold the remote and press K, I or U to select SS-01, SS-03 or SS-04; right click casts the selected strike at the ground in your crosshair; sneak + right click selects the next one. The keys can be rebound. A card beside the hotbar shows the selected strike, its key and its cooldown.

SS-01 Railgun: a red laser marks the ground, and about 18 seconds after the button is pressed a beam 200 blocks in radius comes down and removes the whole column of the world, from the build limit to the void.

SS-03 Gungnir: about 16 seconds after the button is pressed, a black needle strikes from straight above. A shock ring spreads to 400 blocks, shaves the land down to the height of the impact and leaves a molten crater. The needle stays, standing from the bottom of the world to the build limit.

SS-04 Seven Stars: the Big Dipper is projected onto the land, 7 nodes about 1,440 blocks across. 7 stars fall one after another; each digs a crater and leaves a Star Core crystal in it. Then the 7 lines of the figure are burned in as trenches, with Star Trace along their floors.

Films: each strike plays an in-game film for the player who cast it — camera, HUD and scenes in space. Press J to skip a film while it plays; when no film is playing, J turns the films off or on. The strike happens either way.
Cooldown: each strike has its own cooldown of 60 seconds (1 second in creative mode). While your last strike of the same kind is still running, you cannot cast it again.

Four blocks are left behind and can be mined and taken: Block of Tungsten and Thermal Conduit from Gungnir's needle, Star Core and Star Trace from Seven Stars. Three need a diamond pickaxe or better; the Block of Tungsten needs a netherite pickaxe. All four are also in the creative tab.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer and Java 25. For multiplayer, Halia must also be installed on the server.

The strikes permanently destroy terrain on a very large scale, and there is no undo. SS-01 removes everything within 200 blocks of the target, from the build limit down to the void. Gungnir shaves away everything above the height of the impact within 400 blocks of it, and digs a crater at the centre. Seven Stars digs 7 craters and 7 trenches across about 1,440 blocks. Back up your world first, and do not use the Stellar Remote on a world or server you are not prepared to lose parts of.

A strike kills every living thing in its zone — the player who cast it too, if they are standing in it. Only players in creative or spectator mode are spared. Buildings, chests and dropped items in the destroyed area are lost. Outside its zone, Gungnir's shock still throws and hurts creatures up to 1,000 blocks from the impact.
A single strike loads and rewrites hundreds to thousands of chunks, so the game can stutter while it runs.
